name: 即食碗装燕窝糖水炖款
description: 蓝天椰影氛围、留白参数卡与徽章阵列，开碗即食卖点一目了然

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF packshots alternating with cloud-blue #BFDCEE, blush-pink #E8B7B4 panels and warm wood #C8965E surfaces
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with warm window-light scenes, front-left key, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: warm wood table #C8965E, matte cream board #F6EFE8 and clean white board #FFFFFF
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for latin and clean rounded sans for Chinese, no brush calligraphy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular medallion icons in one terracotta accent #B03A2E
styleLock.presentationRules: bowl shown at stable straight-on or slight 3/4 angles, steady scale across the set, bowl always the single hero subject
noDrift: no brush calligraphy or decorative script
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm appetizing tonic-food ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud blue #BFDCEE, blush pink #E8B7B4, terracotta red accent #B03A2E and charcoal text #33383D on clean white #FFFFFF and warm wood #C8965E surfaces; bright soft studio lighting with warm window-light scenes, front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif typography with no brush calligraphy; thin-line circular medallion icon style in one terracotta accent; clean high-end food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements and generous copy whitespace; stable product scale with the bowl as the single hero subject; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表首屏干净合规，赢取点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bowl centered, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bowl centered and photographed straight-on at eye-level, full product visible, upright and unclipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key and fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the bowl on seamless pure white #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace. 8K commercial food e-commerce quality. Negative: no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size, no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges.

shots.lighting: soft even studio light, gentle contact shadow

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1为蓝天白云与棕榈叶背景的头部图，红色毛笔字大标题，下方白瓷碗盛炖煮燕窝糖水并配白色片状配料，置于木纹台面；屏2为白底信息区，红括号标题加副标，大圆角图位为空白占位，参数行重复写『产品名称：燕窝／产品类型：燕窝』；屏3为樱粉底三竖卡版式，卡下标签与两行说明均为与商品无关的模板填充语；屏4为白底六宫格红卡阵列，卡面英文为无意义模板残留；屏5为樱粉圆角面板加大空白图位与三个圆形线描图标；屏6收尾出现会员角标与二维码。品类判定：参数区品名为燕窝，成品画面为即食炖煮碗装形态（糖水同炖、开碗即食），非干盏泡发，故按滋补营养品判为医药保健/营养补充，与历史进口燕窝改判一致。已剥离：毛笔字标题、全部英文模板残留、功效与食疗类表述、会员角标与二维码、参数行具体文字与品牌系列字样；未编造或搬运任何成分含量、规格数值、产地等级、检测报告与认证，原文数值一律改为留白占位或 {callout_n}。
